```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"DSA condemns recent Israeli military attacks on Gaza that led to disproportionate civilian deaths.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"These attacks on Gaza arose in response to Hamas’s unjustifiable rocket attacks on Israeli civilians.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Israel is the hegemonic military and occupying power in the region.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA believes Israel has the primary responsibility to create pre-conditions for peace.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Pre-conditions for peace include a unilateral withdrawal of illegal West Bank settlements.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Pre-conditions for peace include an end to the embargo of civilian goods entering Gaza.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Israel should be willing to negotiate with representatives of the Palestinian people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Representatives of the Palestinian people should promote the peace process by ending attacks on Israeli civilians.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"It is the obligation of the international community, including the United States of America, to make sure that the strategy of coexistence and moderation is rewarded.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Palestinian people should be offered a horizon in which they are able to realize a viable, contiguous, independent state alongside Israel, including a Palestinian capital in East Jerusalem, not through guns and bombs, but via the tools of statecraft and diplomacy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA will work with other pro-peace forces in the American Jewish, Palestinian, Arab, and broader progressive community to pressure the United States to adopt a balanced Middle-East approach.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA supports an end to military aid to Israel that is used for occupation purposes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA supports movements in Israel and Palestine that are committed to a two-state solution.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
